answer.reason: The mutant drops any message whose encoding matches the message just before it. A history with two identical consecutive turns (for example, a user repeating "hi") would come back from save/load one message short. That breaks the requirement that saving and loading preserve the conversation history. The proposed inputs were rejected only because they named ChatRole, not because the two versions behave the same.
